name: see-life-wallpaper
title_zh: 把实时摄像头画面变成会呼吸的壁纸
tagline_zh: 厌倦了静态壁纸？让桌面显示窗外实景、鱼缸或街角。装一次，每次解锁都像换了个新世界。
tagline_en: Tired of static wallpapers? Turn your desktop into a live window—real-time camera feeds that feel new every unlock.
why_zh: 不是简单循环视频，而是真·实时取流：延迟低、自动重连，支持多摄像头轮播。壁纸随世界同步变化。
why_en: Not a looped video—true live streaming with low latency, auto-reconnect, and multi-cam rotation. Your wallpaper mirrors the.
limit_zh: 需要本机有可访问的 RTSP/HTTP 摄像头源；仅支持 Linux + X11 桌面环境；壁纸无音频。
limit_en: Requires accessible RTSP/HTTP camera sources; Linux + X11 only; no audio; freezes on network/camera loss until manual refresh.
